verdict.rationale: LiteLLM proxy's virtual key system directly matches this story: admins mint scoped virtual keys per team/app with budgets, rate limits, and model access controls, while the actual provider API keys stay server-side (litellm-docs-5, litellm-docs-7, litellm-docs-8, litellm-docs-25, litellm-docs-26, litellm-docs-35). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the key-minting workflow (one community comment mentions vague friction 'issues with creating tokens for other users' litellm-comm-3), and no evidence of automated key-rotation/expiry mechanics beyond budget resets.
